verses.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
verses.pt: E depois disso, o Senhor ordenou ainda outros setenta, e os mandou de dois em dois adiante de sua face, para toda cidade e lugar aonde ele havia de vir.
verses.en_web: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place, where he was about to come.
verses.en_bbe: Now after these things, the Lord made selection of seventy others and sent them before him, two together, into every town and place where he himself was about to come.

verses.en: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.pt: E lhes dizia: “A colheita verdadeiramente é grande, mas os trabalhadores são poucos; portanto rogai ao Senhor da colheita para que ele envie trabalhadores para a sua colheita.
verses.en_web: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, There is much grain ready to be cut, but not enough workers: so make prayer to the Lord of the grain-fields that he will send workers to get in the grain.

verses.en: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
verses.pt: Ide; eis que eu vos mando como cordeiros no meio dos lobos.
verses.en_web: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
verses.en_bbe: Go on your way: see, I send you out like lambs among wolves.

verses.en: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
verses.pt: Não leveis bolsa, nem sacola, nem sandálias; e a ninguém saudeis pelo caminho.
verses.en_web: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
verses.en_bbe: Take no bag for money or for food, and no shoes; say no word to any man on the way.

verses.en: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
verses.pt: E em qualquer casa que entrardes, dizei primeiro: Paz seja nesta casa.
verses.en_web: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
verses.en_bbe: And whenever you go into a house, first say, Peace be to this house.

verses.en: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
verses.pt: E se ali houver algum filho da paz, a vossa paz repousará sobre ele; e se não, ela voltará para vós mesmos.
verses.en_web: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
verses.en_bbe: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will be with him: but if not, it will come back to you again.

verses.en: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
verses.pt: E ficai na mesma casa, comendo e bebendo do que eles vos derem; pois o trabalhador é digno do seu salário. Não vos mudeis de casa em casa.
verses.en_web: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
verses.en_bbe: And keep in that same house, taking what food and drink they give you: for the worker has a right to his reward. Do not go from house to house.

verses.en: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
verses.pt: E em qualquer cidade que entrardes, e vos receberem, comei do que puserem diante de vós.
verses.en_web: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
verses.en_bbe: And into whatever town you go, if they take you in, take whatever food is given to you:

verses.en: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.pt: E curai os enfermos que nela houver, e dizei-lhes: Chegado é para vós o reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
verses.en_bbe: And make well those in it who are ill and say to them, The kingdom of God is near to you.

verses.en: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
verses.pt: Mas em qualquer cidade em que entrardes e não vos receberem, saí pelas ruas, e dizei:
verses.en_web: But into whatever city you enter, and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
verses.en_bbe: But if you go into a town where they will not have you, go out into the streets of it and say,

verses.en: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.pt: Até o pó da vossa cidade que ficou em nós, sacudimos sobre vós; porém disto sabeis, que o reino de Deus é chegado até vós.
verses.en_web: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
verses.en_bbe: Even the dust of your town, which is on our feet, we put off as a witness against you; but be certain of this, that the kingdom of God is near.

verses.en: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
verses.pt: E eu vos digo, que mais tolerável será naquele dia para Sodoma, do que para aquela cidade.
verses.en_web: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, It will be better in that day for Sodom than for that town.

verses.en: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.pt: Ai de ti, Corazim! Ai de ti, Betsaida! Porque se em Tiro e em Sidom tivessem sido feitas as maravilhas que foram feitas entre vós, há muito tempo que teriam se arrependido em saco e em cinza.
verses.en_web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.en_bbe: A curse is on you, Chorazin! A curse is on you, Beth-saida! For if such works of power had been done in Tyre and Sidon as have been done in you, they would have been turned from their sins, in days gone by, seated in the dust.

verses.en: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
verses.pt: Portanto, para Tiro e Sidom será mais tolerável no juízo, do que para vós.
verses.en_web: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
verses.en_bbe: But it will be better for Tyre and Sidon, in the day of judging, than for you.

verses.en: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
verses.pt: E tu, Cafarnaum, que pensas estar elevada ao céu, até o Xeol serás derrubada!
verses.en_web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
verses.en_bbe: And you, Capernaum, were you not lifted up to heaven? you will go down to hell.

verses.en: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
verses.pt: Quem vos ouve, ouve a mim; e quem vos rejeita, rejeita a mim; e quem me rejeita, rejeita aquele que me enviou.
verses.en_web: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
verses.en_bbe: Whoever gives ear to you, gives ear to me; and whoever is against you, is against me; and whoever is against me, is against him who sent me.

verses.en: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
verses.pt: E os setenta voltaram com alegria, dizendo: Senhor, até os demônios se sujeitam a nós por teu nome.
verses.en_web: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
verses.en_bbe: And the seventy came back with joy, saying, Lord, even the evil spirits are under our power in your name.

verses.en: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
verses.pt: E disse-lhes: Eu vi a Satanás, que caía do céu como um raio.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I was watching for Satan, falling from heaven like a star.

verses.en: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
verses.pt: Eis que vos dou poder para pisar sobre serpentes e escorpiões, e sobre toda a força do inimigo, e nada vos fará dano nenhum.
verses.en_web: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
verses.en_bbe: See, I have given you power to put your feet on snakes and evil beasts, and over all the strength of him who is against you: and nothing will do you damage.

verses.en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
verses.pt: Mas não vos alegreis de que os espíritos se sujeitem a vós; em vez disso, alegrai-vos por vossos nomes estarem escritos nos céus.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
verses.en_bbe: Do not be glad, however, because you have power over spirits, but because your names are recorded in heaven.

verses.en: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.pt: Naquela hora Jesus se alegrou em espírito, e disse: Graças te dou, o Pai, Senhor do céu e da terra; porque tu escondeste estas coisas aos sábios e instruídos, e as revelaste às crianças. Sim, Pai, porque assim lhe agradou diante de ti.
verses.en_web: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”
verses.en_bbe: In that same hour he was full of joy in the Holy Spirit and said, I give praise to you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have kept these things secret from the wise and the men of learning, and have made them clear to little children: for so, O Father, it was pleasing in your eyes.

verses.en: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
verses.pt: Todas as coisas me foram entregues pelo meu Pai; e ninguém sabe quem é o Filho, a não ser o Pai; nem quem é o Pai, a não ser o Filho, e a quem o Filho o quiser revelar.
verses.en_web: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”
verses.en_bbe: All things have been given to me by my Father: and no one has knowledge of the Son, but only the Father: and of the Father, but only the Son, and he to whom the Son will make it clear.

verses.en: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
verses.pt: E virando-se para seus discípulos, disse -lhes à parte: Bem-aventurados os olhos que veem o que vós vedes.
verses.en_web: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
verses.en_bbe: And, turning to the disciples, he said privately, Happy are the eyes which see the things you see:

verses.en: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.pt: Porque vos digo, que muitos profetas e reis desejaram ver o que vós vedes, e não o viram; o ouvir o que vós ouvis, e não o ouviram.
verses.en_web: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”
verses.en_bbe: For I say to you that numbers of prophets and kings have had a desire to see the things which you see, and have not seen them, and to have knowledge of the things which have come to your ears, and they had it not.

verses.en: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.pt: E eis que um certo estudioso da Lei se levantou, tentando-o, e dizendo: Mestre, o que devo fazer para ter para herdar a vida eterna?
verses.en_web: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
verses.en_bbe: And a certain teacher of the law got up and put him to the test, saying, Master, what have I to do so that I may have eternal life?

verses.en: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
verses.pt: E ele lhe disse: O que está escrito na Lei? Como tu a lês?
verses.en_web: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, What does the law say, in your reading of it?

verses.en: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.pt: E respondendo ele, disse: Amarás ao Senhor teu Deus de todo teu coração, e de toda tua alma, e de todas tuas forças, e de todo teu entendimento; e amarás a teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
verses.en_web: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.en_bbe: And he, answering, said, Have love for the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind; and for your neighbour as for yourself.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
verses.pt: E disse-lhe: Respondeste bem; faze isso, e viverás.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, You have given the right answer: do this and you will have life.

verses.en: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
verses.pt: Mas ele, querendo se justificar, disse a Jesus: E quem é o meu próximo?
verses.en_web: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
verses.en_bbe: But he, desiring to put himself in the right, said to Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

verses.en: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.pt: E respondendo Jesus, disse: Um homem descia de Jerusalém a Jericó, e foi atacado por assaltantes, que também tiraram suas roupas, espancaram-no, e se foram, deixando-o meio morto.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, answering him, said, A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he got into the hands of thieves, who took his clothing and gave him cruel blows, and when they went away, he was half dead.

verses.en: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.pt: E por acaso descia um certo sacerdote pelo mesmo caminho, e vendo-o, passou longe dele.
verses.en_web: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.en_bbe: And by chance a certain priest was going down that way: and when he saw him, he went by on the other side.

verses.en: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
verses.pt: E semelhantemente também um levita, chegando junto a aquele lugar, veio, e vendo-o, passou longe dele
verses.en_web: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
verses.en_bbe: And in the same way, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, went by on the other side.

verses.en: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
verses.pt: Porém um certo samaritano, que ia pelo caminho, veio junto a ele, e vendo-o, teve compaixão dele.
verses.en_web: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
verses.en_bbe: But a certain man of Samaria, journeying that way, came where he was, and when he saw him, he was moved with pity for him,

verses.en: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.pt: E chegando-se, amarrou-lhe um curativo nas feridas, pondo-lhe nelas azeite e vinho; e pondo-o sobre o animal que o transportava, levou-o para uma hospedaria, e cuidou dele.
verses.en_web: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.en_bbe: And came to him and put clean linen round his wounds, with oil and wine; and he put him on his beast and took him to a house and took care of him.

verses.en: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
verses.pt: E partindo-se no outro dia, tirou dois dinheiros, e os deu para o hospedeiro; e disse-lhe: Cuide dele; e tudo o que gastares a mais, eu te pagarei quando voltar.
verses.en_web: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, and gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
verses.en_bbe: And the day after he took two pennies and gave them to the owner of the house and said, Take care of him; and if this money is not enough, when I come again I will give you whatever more is needed.

verses.en: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
verses.pt: Quem, pois, destes três te parece que foi o próximo daquele que foi atacado por assaltantes?
verses.en_web: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
verses.en_bbe: Which of these three men, in your opinion, was neighbour to the man who came into the hands of thieves?

verses.en: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
verses.pt: Ele disse: Aquele que agiu tendo misericórdia com ele.Então Jesus lhe disse: Vai, e faze da mesma maneira.
verses.en_web: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, The one who had mercy on him. And Jesus said, Go and do the same.

verses.en: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que eles, enquanto eles caminhavam, ele entrou em uma aldeia; e uma certa mulher, de nome Marta, o recebeu em sua casa.
verses.en_web: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.en_bbe: Now, while they were on their way, he came to a certain town; and a woman named Martha took him into her house.

verses.en: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
verses.pt: E esta tinha uma irmã, chamada Maria, a qual, sentando-se também aos pés de Jesus, ouvia sua palavra.
verses.en_web: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
verses.en_bbe: And she had a sister, by name Mary, who took her seat at the Lord's feet and gave attention to his words.

verses.en: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verses.pt: Marta, porém, ficava muito ocupada com muitos serviços; e ela, vindo, disse: Senhor, não te importas que minha irmã me deixe sozinha para servir? Dize a ela, pois, que me ajude.
verses.en_web: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”
verses.en_bbe: But Martha had her hands full of the work of the house, and she came to him and said, Lord, is it nothing to you that my sister has let me do all the work? Say to her that she is to give me some help.

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
verses.pt: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhe: Marta, Marta, tu és preocupada com muitas coisas, e perturbada por elas;
verses.en_web: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord, answering, said to her, Martha, Martha, you are full of care and troubled about such a number of things:

verses.en: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
verses.pt: Mas somente uma coisa é necessária. E Maria escolheu a parte boa, a qual não lhe será tirada.
verses.en_web: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
verses.en_bbe: Little is needed, or even one thing only: for Mary has taken that good part, which will not be taken away from her.
